adapters.contract: Actual entry identity selects legacy MFA or exact-hash MXU. MXU uses the saved unique PC instance, direct game pre-action, owned root/agent completion and full native installation fingerprints
limitations: MXU versions outside the exact GF2 v2.8.3/MXU v2.8.1 component set remain unsupported, including v2.8.0 and mixed installations with stale MFA files.

MXU special host actions and independent Web/global-hotkey/scheduled/automatic triggers must be disabled in the native assistant; no preset is edited automatically. Only direct assistant-start PC mode is covered.

Native task failures remain failures; damaged critical callbacks remain unconfirmed. Offline fixtures and read-only installed preparation do not establish Windows game, Job inheritance, normal exit or serial acceptance. The published v0.1.0 binary predates this MXU implementation.
